results.detail: Voice recording consent required before processing call.
Override emitted: True; Response: Omusolo ogw'omuwendo ogwongerwako (VAT) guli ebitundu kkumi na munaana...

final_caller: So, how do I register for a tin number with URA?
final_assistant: Excuse me, did you say ura?

results.spoken_notice: I'm connecting you to a URA officer, please hold.

en_vat_accuracy.text:
The standard rate of Value Added Tax (VAT) is 18 percent, for the 2026 to 2027 financial year. Value Added Tax is charged at 18 percent on taxable supplies of goods and services; VAT-registered businesses collect it from customers and remit it to U R A. - Statutory Basis: Value Added Tax Act

That comes from the official U R A 2026 to 2027 rate table. Would you like more detail?

lg_vat_accuracy.text: Omusolo gw'omugaso omwongere (VAT) mu Uganda guli ebitundu kkumi na munaana ku buli kikumi (18%) ku bintu n'empeereza ezisoloozebwako omusolo okusinziira ku tteeka lya Value Added Tax Act.

sw_tin_accuracy.text:
Ninafurahi kukusaidia kujisajili kwa ajili ya TIN! Kusajiliwa kwa TIN na U R A nchini Uganda:
Hatua moja: Tembelea tovuti rasmi ya U R A kwenye U R A dot go dot u g mbili. Nenda kwenye eServices Usajili wa TIN tatu. Jaza fomu ya maombi mtandaoni na uwasilishe. Je! Ungependa maelezo zaidi?

results.transcript: What is the standard VAT rate in Uganda?
results.reply:
The standard rate of Value Added Tax (VAT) is 18 percent, for the 2026 to 2027 financial year. Value Added Tax is charged at 18 percent on taxable supplies of goods and services; VAT-registered businesses collect it from customers and remit it to U R A. Statutory Basis: Value Added Tax Act

That comes from the official U R A 2026 to 2027 rate table.
